text:
anna_cs: Heads-up — Veridian Health (renewal ~6w) just dropped to <10 API calls/day over the last 2 weeks. No recent logins from power users. New PM (Aisha) started last Tue and mentioned they're evaluating an on-prem competitor. Any quick triage? :eyes:

jordan_csm: Got it. Can you paste last 14d activity & seat list? also any open support tickets?

anna_cs: Sure — quick export from analytics (last 7 days):
```
2026-03-01: 412 calls
2026-03-02: 389 calls
2026-03-03: 22 calls
2026-03-04: 14 calls
2026-03-05: 9 calls
2026-03-06: 7 calls
2026-03-07: 5 calls
```
No open support tickets in the portal; CS notes show fewer invite accepts for the new onboarding flow.

mike_se: Low usage + new PM + private deployment mention = higher churn risk. Two quick asks: which model + route are they hitting, and do we have any recent latency/errors in their traces? If we can show improved p99 and a Dedicated trial, that helps the procurement convo.

anna_cs: They're on `model:redwood-v2-small` via route `veridian-prod`. Traces show a spike in 3/3 with 503 retries (maybe scaling/timeout). Link to traces: https://dash.internal/r/veridian/trace/1234

sam_sales: I'll ping Aisha and the CIO contact to schedule a 30m exec QBR. Suggest we offer a 60-day Dedicated trial (low-friction) + a joint technical workshop for their infra team. If legal wants concessions, we can propose a procurement-friendly SLA window. Thoughts? :+1:

julia_am: Please capture contract end date & any auto-renew clauses before we promise credits. Also note: procurement mentioned longer evaluation cycles for on-prem vendor; we should avoid discounting too quickly. Contract ends 2026-05-12 per CRM.

billing-bot: Invoice #VH-4421 is paid. No outstanding invoices.

jordan_csm: I'll take the customer workshop prep. Can someone drop a 1-pager on Dedicated trial benefits & an example SOW? Need it by EOD so I can attach to the QBR invite.

mike_se: I'll draft a short SRE-runbook that covers:
- how we guarantee p99 under 200ms with Dedicated
- fallback plan to our hosted model during scaling
- suggested batching/prefix-cache tweaks (config snippet below)

```yaml
batching: auto
kv_cache: enabled
timeout_ms: 60000
```

anna_cs: FYI Aisha said the competitor is pitching "node-local KV cache" and air-gapped deployment. She sounded anxious about migration effort. I'll call Aisha now and try to secure a workshop slot next Tue.

sam_sales: Great — I'll loop in procurement & legal. Jordan, set tentative invite for Tue 10am; I'll turn it into an actual calendar once Anna confirms.

jordan_csm: Taking lead on the outreach. I'll also prepare 2 quick customer success anecdotes about adoption ramp and a one-slide cost comparison (hosted vs dedicated pricing delta).

anna_cs: Thanks all. Next steps summary:
- Anna to confirm workshop time with Aisha (taking now)
- Mike to produce SRE runbook + perf screenshots by EOD
- Jordan to prep 1-pager + invite
- Sam/Julia to align on commercial/legal posture

anna_cs: Quick note — if we can get a 2-week proof-of-value on Dedicated with minimal legal attachments, we might lock them before procurement finishes competitor POC. I'll escalate if needed. :eyes:
